envelope.title: D-118 · Keep configuration change history
envelope.body:
A fictional recorded product decision. The quotation explains the reason; it is not a claim that this policy applies to every project.

D-118 is about Partner Workspace: keep configuration change history so the incoming engineer can explain the deployed state.
